LanguageData.MS_UI_FilterControls: Left-click: toggle whitelist. Right-click: toggle blacklist. Blacklists take priority; multiple whitelists match any selected rule.
LanguageData.MS_UI_FilterIconHint: Choose any storable item as the icon. This does not change the rule's allowed items.
LanguageData.MS_UI_FilterDeleteMode: Toggle rule deletion. Click a red cross to delete that custom rule. Click minus again to exit.
LanguageData.MS_UI_FilterEditMode: Toggle rule editing. Click a custom rule to edit its name, filter and icon. Click this button again to exit.
